name: CJ's Custom Apparel
old_description: CJ’s Custom Apparel has served Oklahoma since 2011, offering custom screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film printing, heat transfer printing, promotional products, graphic design, and so much more. As a family owned and operated business, we take great pride in providing the best quality products for our customers.
about:
CJ's Custom Apparel has operated in Edmond, Oklahoma since 2011. The company was founded as a family-owned and operated business, though the founders are not named publicly.

The shop provides custom apparel decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, digital heat-transfer printing, and graphic design. It also supplies promotional products. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

Customers range from businesses and organizations to clubs, bands, and event organizers seeking branded apparel and promotional items.

The company emphasizes its family ownership and over a decade of experience as foundations for quality and service, and it offers in-house graphic design to streamline the ordering process.
